description: A mock exam with list-style options and a task that builds on another.
prompt: Use the fair-practice-questions skill. Probeklausur zu Datenbank-Transaktionen (ACID, Isolation Levels, Locking), 4 Aufgaben, als Markdown. Mindestens zwei Aufgaben sollen Multiple-Choice sein, bei denen jede Option eine Aufzählung ist ('Welche drei ... gehören zu ...?'). Aufgabe 4 soll auf Aufgabe 2 aufbauen. Lösungen am Ende, getrennt von den Aufgaben.

assertions.desc: In every list-style multiple-choice task, all options contain the same number of items.
Distractor lists are built by swapping plausible-but-wrong members (for example real isolation levels or ACID letters), not by dropping or padding items.
No task, option, hint or visible explanation reveals the answer to another task.
Task 4 builds on task 2 without stating task 2's answer in its stem; it is self-contained or applies the mechanism to a new case.
A solutions section follows the last task.
The correct answers of the multiple-choice tasks do not all sit in the same position.
Any hint narrows the reasoning without naming the answer or ruling out all but one option by form.
